sentences.text: 1 first information statement of Smt.SHABNAM SHAIKH.
The gist of the prosecution case is that, complainant got married accused No.1 on 03-11-2012.

After marriage, when complainant and accused were residing together at Neelasandra, Bangalore, accused No.1 forced complainant to bring Rs.5 lakhs dowry from paternal house and did not provide food to the complainant and to her son and did not looked after household expenses and also did not bring household items and get new clothes to the complainant and her son during RAMZAN festival and thereby caused physical and mental cruelty to the complainant.
Based on the information of Smt.SHABNAM SHAIKH.,a case in Cr.No.56/2018 came to be registered against the accused No.1 to 5 for the aforesaid offences .
3. After completion of the investigation, the P.I. of Basavanagudi Women P.S. has filed chargesheet against accused No.1 for the aforesaid offences.
On receipt of charge sheet, this court took cognizance of the alleged offences.
Pursuant to the issuance and service of summons, accused No.1 entered  3  C.C.No.22798/2018 appearance and was enlarged on bail.

The prosecution papers was furnished to the accused No.1 as required U/s.207 of Cr.P.C.
 4.

Before framing charge an opportunity of being heard was provided to the accused No.1 and after hearing him and the prosecution and as there was sufficient materials, the charge for the aforesaid offences was framed and same was read over to the accused No.1 in the language known to him to which, the accused No.1 pleaded not guilty and claimed to be tried.
The plea of the accused No.1 was recorded.

Thereafter, the matter was set down Shabnam Sheik vs Shoib Ulla Khan Md Alias Shoib Ulla Khan on 12 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/49785490/
2 for prosecution evidence.

sentences.text: 5. In order to prove the charges, the prosecution has examined PW-1 and got marked Ex.P1 and Ex.P2 documents.
As there was no any incriminating evidence appearing against the accused No.1, the recording of Statement of Accused No.1 as required U/s. 313 of Cr.P.C., was dispensed with.
6. Heard arguments on both the sides.
I have Perused the materials on record.

7. The following points arise for my determination:-
 1) Whether the prosecution proves beyond all reasonable  doubt that the accused No.1 caused physical and mental  cruelty to the complainant in demand of dowry, and  thereby accused No.1 has committed the offences  punishable U/s. 498A of IPC.& Sec.4 of Dowry  Prohibition Act.?
 4  C.C.No.22798/2018  2) what order?
 8. My finding to the above points are as under:-
 Point No.1 ........In the Negative.
 Point No.2........

As per final order, for the following:-
 R E A SON S  9. POINT No.1 :- It is the fundamental principle of criminal jurisprudence that the prosecution has to prove its case beyond reasonable doubt.
In order to bring home the guilt of the accused No.1, the prosecution has examined complainant Smt. Shabnam Shaik as PW-1 and got marked Ex.P.1 and Ex.P.2 documents.
Ex.P1 is the first information statement and Ex.P.2 is the spot panchanama.

sentences.text: PW-1 in her examination-in-chief deposed that her marriage with accused was performed on 03-12-2012 and after the marriage, accused looked after her well and deposed accused did not subjected her to any physical and mental cruelty in demand of dowry.
PW-1 deposed that there was petty quarrel between her and accused in respect to family issues, for which she went to the police station, there the police have took her signature on documents.
PW-1 identified Ex.P.1 first information statement and  5  C.C.No.22798/2018 also identified her signature at Ex.P1.
PW-1 also identified Ex.P.2 spot Panchanama and her signature at Ex.P2
and she pleaded her ignorance about the contents of Ex.P1 and P.2.
The learned Sr.APP treated PW-1 as hostile witness and cross examined her.
During which PW-1 admitted that she and accused No.1 have compromised the matter and denied all other suggestions.
Though PW-1 was cross examined by the prosecution, nothing worth could be elicited.
11. On appreciation of entire materials on record, it is apparent that PW-1 being the informant, key and material witness has turned hostile to the prosecution case.
Therefore, this court was pleased to reject the prayer of the learned Sr.APP to summon other chargesheeted witnesses.

Even, if the summons was issued to other chargesheeted witnesses, no purpose would be served as the material witness has given go-bye to her own statement and also the valuable time of the court would be saved.

As such other charge sheeted witnesses were dropped and prosecution evidence was Shabnam Sheik vs Shoib Ulla Khan Md Alias Shoib Ulla Khan on 12 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/49785490/
4 taken as closed.

sentences.text: In view of the material witness, turning hostile the prosecution has failed to bring home the guilt of the accused beyond reasonable doubt.
Accordingly, I answer Point No.1 in the Negative.

For the foregoing reasons, I proceed to pass the following:
 ORDER In exercise of power conferred Under Section 248(1) of Cr.P.C., accused No.1 is acquitted for the offences punishable U/s.498A of IPC.& Sec.4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
The bail bond of accused No.1 shall be in force for a period of 6 months.
